result.summary: Fixes node and wallet targeting bugs in two functional wallet tests. In wallet_keypool_topup.py, it ensures backup and restore operations target each node's respective wallet rather than mistakenly reusing node1's files across all output types. In wallet_createwallet.py, it corrects an assertion to test the newly created avoid_reuse wallet rather than re-checking the previous wallet handle.
result.problem: Test coverage for keypool restoration across p2sh-segwit, bech32, and bech32m wallets was ineffective because nodes 2 through 4 were restarted using their original wallets instead of restored backups, causing tests to pass trivially without actually exercising restore functionality. Additionally, encryption verification for wallets created with avoid_reuse in wallet_createwallet.py was bypassed due to checking the wrong variable handle.
evidence: PR description: 'Adding just that assertion on master makes the test fail at node2.'
Commit 215f8b828b: 'The p2sh-segwit, bech32 and bech32m checks therefore passed trivially: that wallet had derived the keys and received the funds itself.'

Commit 13b2d21beb: 'Since c5d3787367 the avoid_reuse section of wallet_createwallet calls w7.walletpassphrase, repeating the assertion made on w7 just before it, so the w8 wallet it creates was never checked for encryption.'
result.card: This pull request fixes logic flaws in wallet_keypool_topup.py and wallet_createwallet.py where tests were asserting against the wrong wallet handles. Because node paths were hardcoded to node1, keypool restore operations for p2sh-segwit, bech32, and bech32m output types were never actually tested, and an avoid_reuse wallet test was duplicating an earlier check instead of validating the intended wallet. The PR ensures each node backs up and restores its own wallet and checks that startup rescan occurs. The author notes that asserting a rescan on master immediately causes node2 to fail, demonstrating that non-legacy keypool restore was previously unexercised.
uncertainties: The patch diff was omitted from the prompt, though the commits and description precisely outline the changes.

risk.why: Mistakes would only cause functional test failures or mask wallet regressions in test environments.
